name: aiweb
description: AIweb: photos of the real world, 1 cent each. Made in San Francisco, for the world.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix app
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,app -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run web --prefix app"
scripts.dev:phone: concurrently -k -n backend,app -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix app"
